source_tier: trade press (single non-primary; substantiates the inferred-shelved basis)
source_notes: Blank-ref fill (Rule F: pairs the existing Status=shelved value; no value change). GEM had Status populated but Status [ref] blank. The RWE/Stena chartered FSRU planned off Lubmin never proceeded: this source documents that RWE (with Stena Power) had been named to develop the Lubmin FSRU but withdrew, and Deutsche ReGas took over the Lubmin site independently with its own vessel (Neptune, later moved to Mukran). That non-advancement under RWE/Stena is the basis for GEM's 'shelved (inferred)' status. NOTE: this is distinct from the operating Deutsche Ostsee/Mukran terminal (Deutsche ReGas, Energos Power) — do NOT conflate; the 2025 Energos Power charter termination is a Mukran event, not this RWE/Stena Lubmin row. ShelvedYear/StopYear [ref] (2025) left blank — the 2025 is GEM's inference-rollover year with no citable event source (see qa).
